research.title: Classification Baselines for Tabular Data with Missing Values
bullets: Prepared tabular classification datasets by checking feature types, documenting missingness patterns, and fitting imputation procedures exclusively on training partitions.
Implemented logistic regression and random forest baselines under a prescribed evaluation protocol, summarizing discrimination and calibration across missingness conditions.

research.title: Regression Baselines under Covariate Shift
bullets: Cleaned regression datasets, standardized continuous predictors using training statistics, and assembled predefined evaluation splits representing changes in predictor distributions.
Implemented ridge regression and nearest neighbor baselines, recording prediction errors and preparing residual summaries for comparison across evaluation splits.

work.title: Data Validation and Batch Processing Maintenance
bullets: Maintained Python routines that validated incoming tabular records, handled malformed fields, and produced consistent error messages for downstream processing.
Added regression tests for assigned parsing defects and documented expected input formats, exception behavior, and routine batch processing checks.

projects.title: Regularized Logistic Regression for Imbalanced Classification
bullets: Implemented a scikit-learn pipeline combining feature standardization and regularized logistic regression, using stratified splits to preserve class proportions.
Compared unweighted and class-weighted baselines through precision-recall curves and confusion matrices, selecting regularization settings using only training-fold cross-validation.

projects.title: Gaussian Mixture Baselines for Clustering
bullets: Implemented Gaussian mixture clustering with scikit-learn on synthetic continuous datasets, varying covariance assumptions within an established baseline workflow.
Compared mixture models with a k-means baseline, inspecting cluster assignments and likelihood behavior across repeated initializations and feature scaling choices.
